name: RTC Name Recovery
description: Recover original variable names from MSVC /RTC1 frame descriptors.
longdescription: Walks `_RTC_CheckStackVars` / `_RTC_CheckStackVars2` frame descriptors emitted by MSVC `/RTC1` debug builds and renames matching Binary Ninja stack variables to their original source names. Registers two actions: 'RTC: Recover Names (Current Function)' and 'RTC: Recover Names (Whole Binary)'.
